verdict.rationale: Rootly is a SaaS incident-management platform (not itself an agent), and its docs explicitly describe an official Rootly MCP Server implementing the Model Context Protocol, exposing incident data and actions as tools usable from Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, or any MCP-compatible client. This is corroborated by a direct probe confirming the documented MCP server page. Missing for 10: independent hands-on third-party validation of the MCP server working in practice, and details on authentication/setup robustness beyond docs.
